incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: routing-service detected >5% error rate increase and repeated cross-region redirects for /v1/generate. Auto-page to oncall. Logs: https://logs.redwood/c/ops/1760501234 • Pager: @alex (oncall)

alex (oncall): on it — paging in. quick ask: is this a router crash, config, or model problem? any customer-facing impact yet?

maria (eng-runtime): quick summary: i rolled the routing config schema change to canary ~2h ago. it deprecated `fallback_policy` in favor of nested `fallback.rules`. router code change assumed missing `fallback.rules` => default to aggressive cross-region fallback to cheaper region. that default ended up selecting wrong model variants in several regions (cheap-quantized variant when not compatible), causing repeated fallback loops and KV-cache misses which then surfaced as 500s & 504s.

maria (eng-runtime): sample log snippet (repeated):
```
[2026-03-15T18:02:12Z] router=rz3 region=us-west request_id=abc123 step=route select_variant=cheap-quantized -> model_incompat -> fallback to eu-central -> select_variant=cheap-quantized -> model_incompat -> loop_count=5 -> 500
```

maria (eng-runtime): TL;DR: schema change left implicit defaults that behave differently. Canary traffic showed small diff, but once canary was promoted cluster-wide, the policy mismatch amplified.

alex (oncall): ok — can we stop the loop quickly? disable smart routing or force pin variants? which is fastest?

jordan (sre): fastest mitigation: disable smart routing boolean at router level so routing becomes regional-static. i can patch the deployment env var or update the configmap. run (will do now):
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/router ROUTER_SMART_ROUTING=false --record
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/router
```

jordan (sre): i'm running the patch now. will monitor.

maria (eng-runtime): concurrently i'm preparing a config rollback that restores explicit `fallback_policy: legacy` and pins `variant_selector: stable` for enterprise routes. rollback command (infra tooling):
```
infra deploy config --service routing --rollback abc123 --reason "revert schema change causing fallback defaults"
```

alex (oncall): @jordan @maria please post exact timestamps when changes go live. i'll update customers & support.

jordan (sre): router env patched at 1760501380. rollout started. current status: 3/4 router pods ready, errors dropping. monitoring: 500-rate down from 6.2% -> 1.1% in 90s.

maria (eng-runtime): rollback job queued at 1760501412, estimated finish ~2m. will post when done.

support-elena: we have inbound tickets from 2 enterprise customers reporting degraded response times — ACME and NovaHealth. raising priority and spinning up DRI channels.

sam (product): customer impact estimate: ~12 minutes of visible errors for ACME (they route heavy traffic to us-east), about 28% elevation in 5xx for enterprise tier during window. possible SLA credit consideration. we should classify P1 and inform sales.

lia (ops): reached out to ACME account team. they've opened an internal incident. asking for mitigation note to send them soon.

jordan (sre): rollback finished at 1760501468, all routing config restored to pre-change state. confirming variant pins are live. rolling metrics look good: lat p95 back to baseline, errors <0.5%.

alex (oncall): mitigation complete: smart routing disabled + config rollback + pinned variants. traffic normalized. i'm going to continue monitoring for 30m; if stable i'll notify incident resolved and handoff.

maria (eng-runtime): root-cause preliminary: schema change introduced a non-explicit default behavior for missing `fallback.rules` that is incompatible with existing variant selection logic. followups: 1) add validation to config schema to reject deprecated-field-only deployments, 2) add unit test for variant-selection when fallback absent, 3) make default behavior explicit and safe, 4) better canary metrics threshold. i'll own the postmortem.

support-elena: noting impacted customers list for postmortem: ACME (enterprise), NovaHealth (enterprise), BetaLabs (platinum). opening support tickets CUST-342, CUST-343, CUST-344.

jordan (sre): handing off monitoring to night oncall @jordan-night at 1760501800. leaving alert channel open.

alex (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 15m (1760501895). postmortem owner: maria. severity: Sev2 (customer impact, degraded for enterprise customers, quick rollback mitigated).

sam (product): please prepare customer-facing summary and timeline for ACME & NovaHealth. lia/sales to coordinate.

maria (eng-runtime): patch in review to add schema validation + blocking CI check. I'll post PR link in followup.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0315-01. Mitigations: disable_smart_routing, rollback_routing_config, pin_variants. timeline: page->patch->rollback->stabilize.

alex (oncall): I will mark this thread resolved if metrics hold for 30m. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
